consent.title: Patient Consent
consent.subtitle: Informed Consent for AI-Assisted Documentation
consent.intro: RogMitra uses AI to assist in documenting your symptoms and medical history. Please read and consent to the following:
consent.point1: Your information will be used only for clinical documentation purposes.
consent.point2: AI-generated summaries are DRAFTS and will be reviewed by a qualified physician.
consent.point3: No diagnosis or prescription will be generated by AI.
consent.point4: Synthetic/demo data is used in this demonstration — no real data is stored.
consent.point5: You may withdraw consent at any time during the session.
consent.point6: ABHA integration, if shown, is in mock/demo mode only.
consent.voiceConsent: I consent to voice recording for transcription purposes.
consent.dataConsent: I consent to my health data being processed for documentation.
consent.aiConsent: I understand AI summaries are drafts for physician review only.
consent.declineMessage: Without consent, the interview cannot proceed. You may speak directly with your physician.

redFlag.description: The following symptom(s) may indicate a medical emergency. Please notify the physician immediately.
redFlag.chestPainMsg: Chest pain may indicate cardiac or pulmonary emergency. Immediate evaluation required.
redFlag.breathlessnessMsg: Severe breathlessness may indicate respiratory or cardiac emergency.
redFlag.lossOfConsciousnessMsg: Loss of consciousness requires immediate medical evaluation.
redFlag.severeBleedingMsg: Severe or uncontrolled bleeding requires immediate attention.
redFlag.suddenHeadacheMsg: Sudden onset severe headache may indicate intracranial emergency (e.g., subarachnoid hemorrhage).
redFlag.ruleBasedNote: ℹ️ Red flags are detected by a rule-based engine — no AI/LLM is used.
redFlag.negationDetected: Negation detected — symptom may not be active
